drafted_from: tool:save-x-bookmarks's own row (its words, input schema, outputs and the reader it packs, tool:read-my-saved-x-posts) and the stand-in test in this folder's test/save-x-posts.test.mjs; the bookmarks come through Composio's X bookmarks action, not a vault token
start_here: Say to your AI: "Save your X bookmarks to your files", with the connection (its Composio account id, owning user id and project id). It keeps the posts in your files and says how many are new.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads X and keeps one file in your files.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Save your X bookmarks to your files", and give it the connection: the X account id, the owning user id and the project id (from tool:list-my-connected-accounts).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-x-bookmarks and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read the answer: how many were read, how many are not kept yet, the newest key (give it back as since next time) and the file name in your files.
